### get_timestamp_of { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.get_timestamp_of }

```python
timelines.Timeline.get_timestamp_of(event_id, *, conversion_maps=True)
```

Get the timestamp for a specific event by its ID.

Returns a TimeStamp for instant events, or a TimeIntervalStamp for
interval events. Searches recursively through children if the event
is not found on this timeline directly.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                                                                  | Description                                            | Default    |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| event_id        | [str](`str`)                                                          | The event identifier to look up.                       | _required_ |
| conversion_maps | [ConversionMapsSpec](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.ConversionMapsSpec`) | C-Maps available through the returned stamp or stamps. | `True`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                       | Description                                                          |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TimeStamp](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeStamp`) \| [TimeIntervalStamp](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeIntervalStamp`) | TimeStamp for instant events, TimeIntervalStamp for interval events. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                           |
|--------|------------------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If no event with the given ID exists. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.timelines import Timeline
>>> parent = Timeline(length=20, unit=TimeUnit.seconds, uid="timeline:1")
>>> child = Timeline(length=10, unit=TimeUnit.seconds, uid="clt1")
>>> parent.add_child(child, offset=5)
>>> parent.add_events([{"event_type": "Note", "instant": 5.0}])
>>> child.add_events(
...     [{"id": "clt1:note:000001", "event_type": "Note", "start": 0.0, "end": 2.5}]
... )
>>> ts = parent.get_timestamp_of("note:000001")
>>> ts.axis  # For instant events
IdCoordinate(5.0, seconds, 'timeline:1')
```

```python
>>> ts = parent.get_timestamp_of("clt1:note:000001")
>>> ts.start.axis  # For interval events
IdCoordinate(5.0, seconds, 'timeline:1')
>>> ts.end.axis
IdCoordinate(7.5, seconds, 'timeline:1')
```

#### See Also {.doc-section .doc-section-see-also}

get_timestamp: Get timestamp by coordinate.
get_event: Get the raw event dict by ID.

### get_timestamp_table { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.get_timestamp_table }

```python
timelines.Timeline.get_timestamp_table(
    coordinates=None,
    conversion_maps=True,
    recursion_limit=None,
    include_events=True,
    include_boundaries=False,
)
```

Generate a timestamp table as a PyArrow Table.

A Timestamp is a cross-section through the timeline hierarchy showing
synchronous coordinates. This method computes local coordinates for
each timeline in the hierarchy at each axis coordinate.

Supports IdCoordinate for automatic child offset resolution:

    >>> # IdCoordinates from child timeline - offsets auto-applied!
    >>> child_coords = [IdCoordinate(v, unit, "child_id") for v in values]
    >>> df = parent.to_dataframe(coordinates=child_coords)

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                                                                                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default   |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| coordinates        | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`) \| [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`)\] \| None | Explicit coordinates to use as the axis. If None, coordinates are extracted from events (and optionally boundaries). Accepts IdCoordinate objects - if timeline_id matches a child, the offset is automatically applied.                                                                             | `None`    |
| conversion_maps    | [ConversionMapsSpec](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.ConversionMapsSpec`)                                                                                        | C-Maps to include as fields. Flexible input: - True: Include all attached conversion maps - str: Map ID or target unit name (e.g., "inches", "seconds") - TimeUnit: Find map by target unit enum - ConversionMap: Include the specific map - list: Mix of the above - None/False: No conversion maps | `True`    |
| recursion_limit    | [int](`int`) \| None                                                                                                                                         | Maximum depth for child traversal. None = unlimited.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`    |
| include_events     | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                                                               | If True and coordinates is None, extract from events.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `True`    |
| include_boundaries | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                                                               | If True, include timeline boundary coordinates.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `False`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [pa](`pyarrow`).[Table](`pyarrow.Table`) | PyArrow Table with schema: - axis: float64 (root coordinate) - {timeline_id}: float64 (nullable, local coordinate per timeline) - {cmap_id}: varies (converted value per C-Map) |
|        | [pa](`pyarrow`).[Table](`pyarrow.Table`) | Each field includes metadata: - unit: TimeUnit.value string (e.g., "seconds", "pixels") - timeline_id: Timeline ID (for timeline fields) - cmap_id: C-Map ID (for C-Map fields) |
|        | [pa](`pyarrow`).[Table](`pyarrow.Table`) | Access metadata via: ``table.schema.field(col_name).metadata``                                                                                                                  |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> table = timeline.get_timestamp_table()
>>> table.column_names
['axis', 'tl:1', 'notes', 'measures']
```

```python
>>> # Include all attached C-Maps
>>> table = timeline.get_timestamp_table(conversion_maps=True)
```

```python
>>> # Include specific C-Maps by target unit
>>> table = timeline.get_timestamp_table(conversion_maps=["inches", "cm"])
```

```python
>>> # Access unit metadata
>>> table.schema.field('axis').metadata[b'unit']
b'seconds'
```

### resolve_subclass { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.resolve_subclass }

```python
timelines.Timeline.resolve_subclass(unit, number_type=None)
```

Return the most specific Timeline subclass for a unit/number_type pair.

Inspects all subclasses and selects the one whose
``_allowed_units`` includes *unit*.  Among candidates the selection
prefers, in order:

1. A class whose default unit uses *number_type* (when supplied).
2. The class with the **smallest** ``_allowed_units`` set (most
   specific domain).

Further-derived subclasses participate in the lookup and can be
selected when they are the most specific matching candidate, such as
a specialized ``BeatGrid`` subclass.

Falls back to the base ``Timeline`` if no subclass claims the unit.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                | Description                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`)             | The time unit to look up.                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | Optional number type for disambiguation (e.g. ``NumberType.fraction`` selects a fractional logical timeline over ``DiscreteLogicalTimeline``). | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                | Description                                              |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [type](`type`)\[[Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)\] | The most specific Timeline subclass that accepts *unit*. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> Timeline.resolve_subclass(TimeUnit.quarters, NumberType.fraction)
<class 'timetoalign.timelines.types.ContinuousLogicalTimeline'>
>>> Timeline.resolve_subclass(TimeUnit.pixels)
<class 'timetoalign.timelines.types.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline'>
```

### to_dataframe { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.to_dataframe }

```python
timelines.Timeline.to_dataframe(
    coordinates=None,
    conversion_maps=True,
    recursion_limit=None,
    include_events=True,
    include_boundaries=False,
    *,
    fields=None,
    units=True,
    format='pandas',
    include_ids=True,
    as_fractions=None,
)
```

Generate timestamps as a pandas DataFrame with formatted field names.

This is the recommended high-level method for getting timestamp data.
It builds on get_timestamp_table() and applies field formatting.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                                                                                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinates        | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`) \| [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`)\] \| None | Explicit coordinates to use as the axis.                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`     |
| conversion_maps    | [ConversionMapsSpec](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.ConversionMapsSpec`)                                                                                        | C-Maps to include as additional fields. Defaults to True (all).                                                                                                                                                                                  | `True`     |
| recursion_limit    | [int](`int`) \| None                                                                                                                                         | Maximum depth for child traversal.                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| include_events     | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                                                               | If True and coordinates is None, extract from events.                                                                                                                                                                                            | `True`     |
| include_boundaries | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                                                               | If True, include timeline boundary coordinates.                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `False`    |
| fields             | \'ColumnNaming \| Callable\[\[str, dict\], str\] \| list\[str\] \| None\'                                                                                    | How to name the DataFrame fields. Options: - None or ColumnNaming.name (default): Use timeline/cmap name - ColumnNaming.id: Use timeline/cmap id - Callable: Function taking (name, metadata_dict) -> new_name - list[str]: Explicit field names | `None`     |
| units              | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                                                               | If True (default), append units to field names like "name (unit)".                                                                                                                                                                               | `True`     |
| format             | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                                 | Output format. Currently only "pandas" is supported.                                                                                                                                                                                             | `'pandas'` |
| include_ids        | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                                                               | If True (default), add event IDs as the DataFrame index when coordinates are collected from events.                                                                                                                                              | `True`     |
| as_fractions       | [bool](`bool`) \| None                                                                                                                                       | If True, render float coordinate fields as Fraction objects. If None, enable this for fraction-based timelines.                                                                                                                                  | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                           | Description                                          |
|--------|------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | pandas DataFrame with:                               |
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | - Fields named according to the ``fields`` parameter |
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | - Units appended if ``units=True``                   |
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | - Integer fields using pandas nullable Int64 dtype   |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> df = timeline.to_dataframe()
>>> df.columns
Index(['axis (pixels)', 'dgt1 (pixels)', 'pixels_to_inches (inches)'])
```

```python
>>> # Without units in field names
>>> df = timeline.to_dataframe(units=False)
>>> df.columns
Index(['axis', 'dgt1', 'pixels_to_inches'])
```

### to_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.to_dict }

```python
timelines.Timeline.to_dict(events=False, external_references=False)
```

Convert timeline to a dictionary for serialization.

The default output describes the timeline's structure only: the
``"events"`` and ``"external_references"`` keys are **absent**
unless explicitly requested, which keeps the payload small for the
common case of persisting a hierarchy rather than its contents.

Coordinate-valued members — ``length`` and every child
``offset`` — are emitted as the canonical rational wire dict
(:func:`~timetoalign.core.rational_to_wire`), so the result is
JSON-serializable whatever the timeline's number type, and
``Fraction`` coordinates survive the round trip exactly.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Default   |
|---------------------|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| events              | [bool](`bool`) | If True, include an ``"events"`` key holding this timeline's event rows.                                                                                                                                                 | `False`   |
| external_references | [bool](`bool`) | If True, include an ``"external_references"`` key holding the reference table as a list of row dicts (``access_points`` as a nested list of ``{"uri": ..., "kind": ...}`` dicts). Included even when the table is empty. | `False`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                                    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | A JSON-serializable dictionary representation of the timeline. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> "events" in tl.to_dict()
False
>>> "events" in tl.to_dict(events=True)
True
```

### to_typed { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.to_typed }

```python
timelines.Timeline.to_typed()
```

Return this timeline re-instantiated as the appropriate typed subclass.

Uses the timeline's unit and number type to determine the correct
concrete subclass (e.g., ``ContinuousPhysicalTimeline`` for seconds/float).
If the timeline is already an instance of the correct subclass, returns
``self`` unchanged.

This is useful after deserialization (e.g., ``Timeline.from_dict()``) or
when working with generic ``Timeline`` instances that should carry
domain-specific type information.

Events, external references, conversion maps, regions, flow maps, and
metadata are preserved. Children are recursively re-typed.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                        |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'Timeline\' | A Timeline instance of the appropriate typed subclass, or ``self`` |
|        | \'Timeline\' | if it is already the correct type.                                 |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> tl = Timeline(length=10.0, unit=TimeUnit.seconds)
>>> typed = tl.to_typed()
>>> type(typed).__name__
'ContinuousPhysicalTimeline'
>>> typed.is_continuous
True
```

```python
>>> # Already typed -- returns self
>>> cpt = ContinuousPhysicalTimeline(length=10.0)
>>> cpt.to_typed() is cpt
True
```

### unfold_coordinate { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.unfold_coordinate }

```python
timelines.Timeline.unfold_coordinate(coord, id='default')
```

Convert a folded coordinate to unfolded coordinates.

Convenience method that delegates to the attached FlowMap.
Since repeats can cause a folded coordinate to appear multiple times
in the unfolded timeline, this returns a list.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                        | Default     |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|-------------|
| coord  | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`) | Coordinate in the folded timeline. | _required_  |
| id     | [str](`str`)                                        | Which FlowMap to use.              | `'default'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                               | Description                                   |
|--------|------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[float](`float`)\] | List of coordinates in the unfolded timeline. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                  |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If no FlowMap with the given id is attached. |

### validate_child { #timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.validate_child }

```python
timelines.Timeline.validate_child(child, offset)
```

Validate that a timeline can be added as a child.

A timeline can accommodate events and other timelines, called
Children, as long as they use the same measuring unit.

For cross-domain relationships (e.g., physical to logical), use
TimelineGroup instead of parent-child nesting.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                    | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------|
| child  | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)   | The timeline to validate.      | _required_ |
| offset | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`) | The proposed start coordinate. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                         |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If child is not a Timeline.                         |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If units don't match or child already has a parent. |
